name: Skywalk Holidays MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Skywalk Holidays Nepal — explore tour packages, flight ticketing, hotel reservations, and submit travel inquiries.

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Search available international holiday tour packages by country (e.g., Thailand, Bali, China, Vietnam, Dubai).

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get official Skywalk Holidays hotline phone numbers, email, WhatsApp, and office address.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a booking inquiry for tour packages, flight ticketing, hotel reservations, or visa assistance.
